title: GitHub source: authenticate API calls to lift the 60/hour limit
description: The live pod calls api.github.com unauthenticated: rate_limit core limit=60/hour (checked from pod 2026-11-01). After 60 lookups per hour every /v1/github call fails. Since PR chore/refresh-2026-11 a 403 maps to 502 instead of a false 404. Fix: read an optional GITHUB_TOKEN env in platforms.ts and send 'Authorization: Bearer'; needs a fine-grained PAT with public read only, sealed as a SealedSecret in square context/lateststable/infra and wired into the Deployment env. The PAT creation is Rutger's step (use the pat-url skill).

title: GitHub source: fall back to tags for repos without Releases
description: /v1/github/python/cpython, golang/go and postgres/postgres return 404 'No releases found' (verified live 2026-11-01): these repos publish tags, not GitHub Releases. A tags fallback (git/matching-refs or /tags) helps cpython (v3.15.2 style tags). golang/go tags are go1.27.3 and postgres tags are REL_18_6, so they need per-format normalization or stay unsupported. The docker and homebrew sources already answer these correctly (library/python 3.15.2, library/golang 1.27.3, library/postgres 18.6).
